# Implementation Plan: Service Provider Directory

**Branch**: `003-service-directory` | **Date**: 2026-08-22 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/003-service-directory/spec.md`

**Note**: This file is generated by `/speckit-plan`; the artifact definitions below drive the implementation.

## Summary

Add a condominium-wide directory of recommended service professionals. Authenticated
residents (`owner` or `tenant` roles in their condominium) can submit a recommended
professional with name, category, phone number, optional notes, and their unit recorded
automatically. Everyone in the condominium can browse, search by keyword, and filter by
category. The `syndic` can add/rename/deactivate categories and edit or delete any
listing; residents cannot edit or delete listings. New listings are visible immediately,
with a warning (but no block) when the same phone number is already present. Access is
limited to authenticated users who belong to the condominium.

Technical direction for this feature: **standard library first** (no web frameworks, no
ORM, no migration framework) and **CSS-first over JavaScript**, keeping the
constitution-mandated GOTTH presentation stack (Templ, Tailwind CSS, HTMX). Search and
filtering are plain SQL over a small directory table — no search engine is justified at
this scale.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Go 1.27 (module `github.com/leoarkiteto/zelo`), using the Go
standard library as the primary toolset.

**Primary Dependencies**:
- `github.com/a-h/templ` — server-rendered templates (constitution-mandated)
- Tailwind CSS + HTMX — CSS-first styling and minimal progressive enhancement
  (constitution-mandated)
- `github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib` — PostgreSQL driver registered with stdlib
  `database/sql` (driver only; no ORM)

**Storage**: PostgreSQL (local `docker-compose.yml` container) accessed via
`database/sql` + `pgx` stdlib driver and plain SQL. New tables:
`service_categories`, `service_provider_listings`. Existing tables reused:
`users`, `condominiums`, `units`, `unit_occupancies`, `user_roles`, `sessions`,
`audit_events`.

**Testing**: stdlib only — `testing`, `net/http/httptest`, and integration tests against
the dockerized PostgreSQL. TDD is mandatory: directory tests are written first.

**Target Platform**: Linux server (server-rendered web application).

**Project Type**: web application (server-side GOTTH stack; no client-side SPA).

**Performance Goals**: Directory list, search, and filter render in under 1 second for
a typical condominium (hundreds of listings); submission completes in under 2 minutes
of user time (spec SC-001, SC-002).

**Constraints**:
- Standard library first: no web framework, no ORM, no session/migration/CSRF frameworks.
- CSS-first over JavaScript: presentation and interaction state come from Tailwind CSS;
  HTMX is used only for server-driven partial updates required by the GOTTH stack.
- CSRF protection on all state-changing routes (existing synchronizer-token middleware).
- Migrations are plain forward-only SQL files applied by the existing minimal runner.
- Vertical slice isolation: directory handler/service/store code lives in its own slice
  and reaches other slices only through shared `internal/model`, `internal/middleware`,
  and `internal/config`.
- No client-side SPA framework.

**Scale/Scope**: Hundreds of users and hundreds of listings per condominium; one
condominium per user session for v1; single category list per condominium.

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Principle | Status | Notes |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| I. GOTTH Stack | PASS | Go server + Templ + Tailwind + HTMX; no SPA. Directory pages are server-rendered HTML. |
| II. Modular Monolith with Hexagonal Architecture | PASS | Directory use cases in `internal/service` depend only on interfaces; adapters in `internal/store`; HTTP in `internal/handler`; shared models in `internal/model`. |
| III. Vertical Slice Feature Isolation | PASS | Directory slice spans `handler → service → store` only; shared code restricted to `internal/model`, `internal/middleware`, `internal/config`. |
| IV. Test-First Development (NON-NEGOTIABLE) | PASS | Tests written first with stdlib `testing`/`httptest`; integration tests cover listing create/search/filter, duplicate warning, syndic moderation, category lifecycle, and access control. |
| V. SOLID, Design Patterns & Generated Code | PASS | Generated `*_templ.go` and Tailwind output produced only by `scripts/`; no hand edits to generated artifacts. |
| VI. Standard Library First & CSS-First | PASS | `database/sql` + plain SQL; no ORM, no search engine; CSS-first with HTMX limited to progressive enhancement. |
| Repository Layout & Conventions | PASS | Follows existing layout: `internal/{handler,service,store,model}`, `web/templates`, `migrations/`, `scripts/`. |

**Gate result**: PASS — no violations requiring justification.

**Post-design re-check (after Phase 1)**: Still PASS. The data model adds
`service_categories` and `service_provider_listings` with plain-SQL-friendly shapes,
keeps the recommending unit as a snapshot plus optional FK, and stays implementable
with `database/sql` inside `internal/store`, leaving `internal/service` framework-free.

## Project Structure

### Documentation (this feature)

```text
specs/003-service-directory/
├── plan.md              # This file (/speckit-plan command output)
├── research.md          # Phase 0 output (/speckit-plan command)
├── data-model.md        # Phase 1 output (/speckit-plan command)

```

### Source Code (repository root)

```text
cmd/web/                          # main entrypoint: wire config → store → service → handler → middleware
internal/
├── auth/                         # existing session manager + CSRF + password hashing (unchanged)
├── config/                       # existing env config (unchanged)
├── handler/
│   ├── directory.go              # directory list/search, new listing, syndic edit/delete, category management
│   ├── deps.go                   # extend Dependencies with DirectoryService/CategoryService/stores
│   └── router.go                 # register directory routes with member/syndic middleware
├── middleware/                    # existing auth guard, CSRF, logging, recovery, security headers
├── model/
│   ├── listing.go                # ServiceCategory, ServiceProviderListing
│   └── ...                        # existing auth/RBAC models (unchanged)
├── service/
│   ├── directory.go              # directory use cases: submit listing, search, moderate, manage categories
│   ├── ports.go                  # extend with ListingStore/CategoryStore ports
│   └── ...                        # existing auth services (unchanged)
└── store/
    ├── listings.go               # database/sql adapters for listings + categories
    └── ...                        # existing adapters (unchanged)
migrations/
└── 0007_create_service_directory.sql   # service_categories + service_provider_listings + indexes
web/templates/
├── directory.templ               # directory list/search/filter, listing form, edit/delete, category management
└── ...                            # existing templates (unchanged)
```

**Structure Decision**: Single server-rendered web application, one new vertical slice
(`directory`) added alongside the existing auth/RBAC slice. Category management is
included in the same slice because it is part of the directory's data and lifecycle.
